scope: Deterministic triage, referral, citation, actionability, freshness and safety checks. These cases are invented and do not describe real residents.
expertReviewRequired: Automated passage does not establish legal, social-work, or domestic-violence safety. Cases with expertReview=true require qualified review before public launch.
